    THE PLAYBOOK

    Grow your bag.

    Absorb supply dots and smaller holders. Their share becomes yours. Your six-second spawn shield protects you from being eaten, but you can absorb smaller holders immediately. After it expires, bigger holders can eat you. Stay inside the outer wall and steer around the solid shapes.

    MOVEWASD or arrow keys take over from the mouse. Release the keys to stop; click the arena to return to mouse steering. You can also drag on touch screens. Holding your mouse at a screen edge keeps you moving.
    SPACESplit in your movement direction to catch smaller holders. Up to 16 bubbles.
    CConsolidate after the 5-second split cooldown. Bubbles also merge automatically when you steer them over each other.
    ETap or hold E to drop orbs behind you and gain a small forward boost. Each burst uses some of your size.

    Practice against AI opponents. Wallets and token holdings are fictional.
